summary.text: Chris Danou is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Treig Pronschinske (R).
Danou previously served in the Assembly, representing District 92, from 2009 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Danou assumed office in the Wisconsin State Assembly in 2009 and left office in 2017.
He was re-elected in 2010 in District 91, then won re-election in 2012 and 2014 in District 92.
In 2016, Danou, then the incumbent, was defeated in the District 92 general election by Treig Pronschinske, 52.04 percent to 47.96 percent.
